introduction: Idaho LIHEAP has seasonal heating and crisis-assistance routes. Contact the Community Action Agency serving your area, especially if a shutoff or shortage of bulk fuel is imminent.
description: Idaho LIHEAP has seasonal heating and crisis-assistance routes. Contact the Community Action Agency serving your area, especially if a shutoff or shortage of bulk fuel is immi

sections.who: The state lists Idaho residence, household financial rules, identity, heating expenses and at least one qualifying-status household member. Crisis intake additionally considers disconnection, arrears or less than 48 hours of bulk fuel.
sections.get: Eligible seasonal households may receive a heating-assistance payment. Crisis benefits have a separate prior-payment restriction; ask the agency which route and program period apply.
sections.docs:
• Identification and current household income records.
  • Proof of heating expense and the latest bill.
  • Any shutoff notice, arrears statement or bulk-fuel information.
sections.apply:
1. Contact your Community Action Agency

    Use DHW’s heating-assistance page for the local intake route.

  2. Explain seasonal or crisis needs

    Give the agency the exact service date or fuel situation. Ask about this program year’s intake and the current document checklist.

  3. Submit energy-assistance records

    Complete the linked application and provide the evidence requested by the local agency.
sections.after: Confirm the outcome with the provider and utility. Pending intake does not itself cancel a shutoff or confirm payment.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Idaho seasonal and crisis heating intake. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Is crisis assistance the same as seasonal assistance?
No. The state lists separate crisis conditions and a previous-crisis-payment restriction.
Can a bulk-fuel shortage be considered?
The crisis criteria include households with less than 48 hours of bulk fuel.
Can I rely on an older income table?
Ask the local agency for the current program-year limits; the linked page’s displayed table is dated October 2025.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
